US Energy Secretary Chris Wright is expected to announce the funding as soon as Monday during a planned visit to the Perry nuclear complex northeast of Cleveland. items.original_title: FinancialJuice: Hackers breached the propulsion system of US-bound oil tanker

evidence.headline: FinancialJuice: Hackers breached the propulsion system of US-bound oil tanker
evidence.snippet: FBI and US Coast Guard investigators have found evidence that hackers accessed the propulsion system of an oil supertanker as it approached the Texas coast this summer, according to US officials familiar with the matter. The unusual breach highlights the growing physical risks posed by cyberattacks. The cyberattack gave outsiders temporary access to the ship’s digital systems, the officials said, asking not to be identified because they were not authorized to discuss the matter. Officials are still investigating how the breach occurred and who was behind it. It remains unclear how long the hackers had access or what they may have been able to control aboard the ship.

evidence.snippet: Saudi Arabia is preparing an offensive against Iran-backed Houthi militants in Yemen, with options under consideration including a coastal advance to secure the Red Sea shipping route or an assault across multiple fronts, according to regional and Western officials. The operation is expected to begin in the coming weeks and will be led by Yemeni ground forces overseen by Riyadh, with support from Saudi air strikes, according to six people familiar with the preparations.
